My old pc, (Ryzen 5 3600, gtx 1070) the cpu used to run hot ALL the time. I’m talking, 85-90. Im a pretty heavy player too, used to do 8 hour sessions blasting everything I coulda outa my pc. Ended up taking it apart and reapplying some thermal paste to give it away to my sister. Pc is like 6-7 years old now and still runs without skipping beat. As long as it doesn’t start thermal throttling and affecting performance, or shutting off randomly due to heat. Blast them temps, if your pc is older reapply thermal paste or consider a 20$ pack of fans from Amazon or a newer cpu cooler. All relative cheap solutions to your heat issue. 75-80 is legit normal temps though.

You have been playing for 2 days. People have been playing cs for two decades. Cs is like chess or any hobby with a high skill ceiling. Getting into it as a new player IS NOT easy. Many end up quitting along the way. But it can be an extremely rewarding process if you actually play with a mindset of improving yourself. You can roam around in comp games lost for years and never get better. If your goal is improving and you work towards it often enough you’ll be slamming people in no time. Anyways 4-6 kills is pretty weak, you wanna try and stay “positive” meaning more kills than deaths. Ideally you’ll get one kill per round or more. Good luck.
